spatial_complementarity.finding: Immediate anti-recruitment return depends jointly on live recruitment pressure and institutional conversion capacity; threat alone is not the efficient statistic.
spatial_complementarity.interpretation: High threat is valuable only when the state can convert nominal public capital into political access; strong institutions with little live recruitment pressure also have low absolute immediate suppression return.

dose_saturation.finding: State-building return per incremental public-capital unit falls sharply as the budget ceiling rises beyond the moderate-dose regime.
dose_saturation.interpretation: The marginal-return allocation rule is strongest at low/moderate dose and loses much of its advantage at high dose as conversion channels saturate and government capital becomes binding.

temporal_absorptive_capacity.finding: Nearly identical total government outflow can produce materially different durable state outcomes solely because of spending sequence.
temporal_absorptive_capacity.interpretation: Front-loading spends down fungible government capital before slower governance processes can use it. In this synthetic mechanism, pacing is therefore part of absorptive capacity rather than a cosmetic implementation detail.

synthesized_model_principle: Development efficiency in Pineland is a state-dependent, saturating, path-dependent return surface. The next unit of nominal public capital is most productive where a live recruitment margin and sufficient institutional conversion capacity coincide; the best destination changes as local production saturates; and spending too quickly can lower durable state output even when eventual total outflow is essentially unchanged.

cost_reporting.usd_formula: If an external calibration assigns B USD to one default monthly policy budget, then 1 Pineland capital unit = B/120000 USD and 1200 capital = 0.01*B USD.
cost_reporting.cost_per_prevented_recruit_formula: Once a completed dynamic assay estimates R represented recruits prevented per 1200 incremental public capital, the corresponding calibrated cost is 0.01*B/R USD per represented recruit prevented. No B or R is supplied by this synthesis.
